evidence: The authoritative approval remains actionable beyond the old hook timeout

evidence: No MCP call occurs and the Turn records the visible error

Session-scoped agents receive the MCP hook registry.

Deny produces zero dispatches; Allow once produces one dispatch.
The take records compatibility Session ownership; it does not claim MCP tools are wired into the native Session provider loop.
